name: Blonde Lazy Luxury Living Room Portrait
image_vibe: soft glam, relaxed, upscale, warm and intimate
image_purpose: Create a polished but effortless social-media lifestyle portrait in a modern luxury living room.

prompt.project_info: Photorealistic vertical lifestyle portrait, 9:16, 3840x2160 target resolution, natural warm D65 color balance, rendered with realistic path-traced detail.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman with bleached-blonde, long messy-chic waves, symmetrical center part, visible individual hair strands, soft-glam makeup with sharp feline winged eyeliner, nude-beige eyeshadow, clear high-shine lip gloss, natural pore-level skin detail and a soft matte finish. She wears a black micro-ribbed elastane bandeau crop top, a high-waisted black silk-blend skirt with a thigh-high left-side slit and ruched side knot, layered gold chains with small circular pendants, and a thin gold bracelet on her right wrist. No resemblance to Billie Eilish or any other public figure.
prompt.composition_elements: The subject is reclined on a beige oversized sectional, leaning her weight on the right armrest. Her right hand is flattened on the sofa cushion and her left hand rests relaxed on her upper thigh. She makes direct-to-lens eye contact with a soft gaze. Set the scene in an upscale modern living room with eggshell warm-yellow walls, floor-to-ceiling mirrored panels with subtle edge beveling, heavy-weave linen upholstery, earth-tone kilim-patterned throw pillows, and reflected minimalist kitchen cabinetry, stainless-steel refrigerator, wooden dining set, and modern cylindrical black pendant lights.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm 3000K ceiling track lighting combined with directional natural daylight from a side window. Use soft contact shadows, minimal harsh edges, and warm, quiet luxury atmosphere. Reflected highlights in the mirrors should render as soft orbs.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm wide-angle lens, f/2.8 shallow depth of field, pin-sharp focus on the subject's eyes, natural perspective, realistic fabric and hair texture, clean vertical social-media framing.
